headline: Review your property taxes.
subhead: Understand how CT property taxes affect your monthly housing payment. Swipe.

slides.title: Check the mill rate
slides.text: Every town in Connecticut sets its own mill rate annually. One mill equals one dollar of tax per one thousand dollars of assessed value.

slides.title: Find assessed value
slides.text: In Connecticut, assessed value is typically seventy percent of the appraised market value, not the purchase price.

slides.title: Calculate annual tax
slides.text: Multiply the assessed value by the local mill rate, then divide by one thousand to find your exact yearly property tax amount.

slides.title: Include in escrow
slides.text: Your mortgage lender collects one twelfth of your annual property tax bill each month to hold in an escrow account for payment.

caption:
Property taxes catch many buyers off guard in Ridgefield CT. When you look at homes this November, remember that Connecticut calculates assessments at seventy percent of market value, not purchase price. Each town sets a specific mill rate that determines your annual bill. Understanding this math prevents surprises in your monthly mortgage payment. I use my engineering background to break down these exact numbers for my clients so every cost is clear before making an offer.
